title: Othering and Low Status Framing of Immigrant Cuisines in US Restaurant Reviews and Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Linguistic and regression analysis of adjectival framing (e.g., exoticism, authenticity, luxury, cost, hygiene) using hand-crafted dictionaries on both human-written Yelp reviews and LLM-generated reviews across different immigrant and non-immigrant cuisines.

Comparing linguistic framing and status evaluations between white-associated (European) and non-white-associated (Asian, Latin American) cuisines, and evaluating the interaction between neighborhood racial demographics and 'othering' frames using linear regression.
